Revenue over the selected calendar dates shifted back one year. Blank for selections spanning multiple years or absent prior data. Use DimDate for date slicing.
IF(NOT ISBLANK([Revenue]) && NOT ISBLANK([Revenue PY]), [Revenue] - [Revenue PY])
Selected revenue minus prior-year comparable-date revenue; blank without a comparison.
Revenue change divided by prior-year revenue; blank for missing or zero baselines. Incomplete periods must be disclosed.
Distinct delivered orders with selected sales items, counted once per order.

CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Orders), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(FactSales[OrderID]), Orders[order_id])), KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "delivered"), FILTER(Orders, NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) && NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_estimated_delivery_date])))
Delivered orders with both actual and estimated delivery dates, used as the late-rate denominator.

CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Orders), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(FactSales[OrderID]), Orders[order_id])), KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "delivered"), FILTER(Orders, NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) && NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_estimated_delivery_date]) && INT(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) > INT(Orders[order_estimated_delivery_date])))
Eligible orders arriving after the estimated calendar date. Same-day arrival is on time.
IF([Delivery Eligible Orders] > 0, DIVIDE(COALESCE([Late Orders], 0), [Delivery Eligible Orders]))
Late orders / eligible delivered orders; blank when no eligible deliveries exist.

CALCULATE(AVERAGEX(FILTER(Orders, NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_purchase_timestamp]) && NOT ISBLANK(Orders[order_delivered_customer_date]) && Orders[order_delivered_customer_date] >= Orders[order_purchase_timestamp]), DATEDIFF(Orders[order_purchase_timestamp], Orders[order_delivered_customer_date], DAY)), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES(FactSales[OrderID]), Orders[order_id])), KEEPFILTERS(Orders[order_status] = "delivered"))
Mean calendar days from purchase to actual delivery, one observation per delivered order. Missing or negative durations excluded.
Selected orders with at least one valid 1–5 review score.
Mean of each selected order’s mean valid review score. Equal weight per order prevents multiple responses or sales items overweighting an order.
